newsitem.title: USA: Miami Springs, Fla., scraps $5 mln GO referendum.
newsitem.headline: Miami Springs, Fla., scraps $5 mln GO referendum.

text.p: City of Miami Springs, Fla., has pulled a $5 million general obligation bond proposal off the Nov 5 ballot, City Manager Frank Spence said Friday.

Proceeds from the bonds would have financed the purchase of the Miami Springs Golf Course from the City of Miami. The Miami Springs City Council voted Thursday night to withdraw the referendum after negotiations with the City of Miami fell through earlier in the day.
"They said they weren't interested in selling the golf course at this time," Spence said.
Miami Springs issued requests for underwriter proposals for the bond issue on Aug 22. They were due back Sept 17.
Spence said the city would send a cancellation notice to underwriters.
